findings.title: In the phone Desktop layout a sideways swipe begun on the schedule does not pan it
findings.steps: Phone 390x844, Saturday board, More > Desktop layout. Real touch swipe (Chromium touch events) leftwards from x=340 at y=130..800, and from y=500 across the schedule.
findings.expected: the board pans sideways to the crew column and the Done button (790px of travel)
findings.happened: from the schedule body the board moved 14px of 790 (0 from y=90 down); only swipes begun on the top strip (y about 20-60) pan, 275-299px a time. The inner scroller has overscroll-behaviour contain.
findings.note: Chromium emulation; an iPhone may behave differently - confirm on the device.

findings.title: Panning by swiping the day-chip row also changes the open day
findings.steps: Same board at the left edge on Saturday, swipe left along the second bar row (the Mon-Sun chips), y=50.
findings.happened: it panned 285px and the board moved from Sat 18 to Thu 16; repeated swipes walked it on (5, 3, 6, 3, 0). Swipes along the title row (y=20) pan and leave the day alone.
